## 2. Checklist-accuracy findings

From #25812 (priority:P0) — each is a ledger edit for the lane owning the checklist:

- RUNNER environment facts: (1) the walled-boot entry is stale — `examples/app-showcase/package.json` now declares `@objectstack/organizations`, so a walled run boots from the tree with three env vars, no scratch copy; (2) the Playwright entry is stale — `/opt/pw-browsers` now holds chromium 1243 and the alias resolves there (the alias advice still works).
- `platform-core.boot-health` c2: deployment-policy unbound flows print as ℹ lines, not ⚠; the clause still describes ⚠.
- `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render`: the console-added "All reports" sidebar destination is outside both meta/app nav and `SURFACES`, so the served-vs-SURFACES diff cannot see it; step 1's `test:smoke` also collects two other specs beside the pin.
- `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render`: marketplace knownGap names "Forbidden", the screen reads "HTTP 502 · fetch failed" (MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED); step 6 names `sys_approval_request/my_pending` for Account Approvals, the served entry is `component/approvals/inbox`; no clause covers a member opening Setup's url-type entries (they render inside the Showcase shell while the server refuses every namespace 403).
- `approvals.account-app-entry`: "drawer" wording in steps 6–7 and acc[1], acc[3], acc[4] is stale — objectui removed the side sheet (objectui#12484); a row click or `?request=` now opens `/apps/APP/sys_approval_request/record/ID`; the account app answers on two URL segments (`account` and `com.objectstack.account`), which matters for acc[5].
- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip`: the owner half of acc[6] says "not yet run" — it was replayed this run.
- `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` step 2: an `schemaMode: 'external'` datasource needs an `external: {}` block or it answers 400, easy to misread as a refusal.
- `automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable`: steps 2/8/10 task POST needs `project`; step 4's "reads are open" holds only at the apiMethods layer (a contributor gets 403 on `sys_metadata_activation`).
- `identity-auth.default-organization-boot-invariant`: step 3 filters `organization = default`, the column is `organization_id` and takes the org id; `fixtures.requires` says `--fresh` but c1 needs `--log-level info` and a readable file DB; acc[0] prescribes `--maxWorkers=2` against RUNNER's memory fact.
- `platform-core.seed-integrity`: the Specimen diff should name the canonical time form ("14:30" → "14:30:00"); step 2's baseline lists 9 of the 19 seeded datasets.
- `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` knownGaps[1]: a plain member reads the whole org `sys_user` directory, not a self-scoped row (`sys_account` / `sys_session` are the self-scoped ones); the pin header says 6 delegate × sys_* rows, the matrix has 4.
- `access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only`: steps name showcase objects while the wall-* dogfood pins boot the CRM app — worth stating in the item.
- `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`: planning a raw v17 DB before any v18 boot blocks the apply at the `rewrite` step (resumable after one boot) — put the refused boot before the plan; apply needs `OS_AUTH_SECRET` (or `--dev`) or it blocks at `authored-conversion`; on a real 17.x DB the drop gate's first refusal is `refused_comment_reactions_unconverted`, so `os migrate comment-reactions --apply --yes` (step 4, which also lacks `--yes`) must come before step 3; acc[0] prescribes `--maxWorkers=2`; c5 knownGaps should say a published prerelease CLI is no substitute.
- `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` step 1: production `os serve --preset minimal` is refused earlier ("This stack mounts no auth…"); `os serve --dev --no-server` is the spelling that reaches the SecurityPlugin refusal.
- `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` steps 2 and 9: the INFO lines need `--log-level info` on `os start`; `query_records` caps `limit` at 50.

## 3. Fixture gaps, partial coverage and not-run handover

From #25812 (priority:P0); no not-run items.

- `access-security.rls-both-sides` acceptance[5] — blocked(dependency): the D11 judgement needs the private write-up the item's knownGaps names.
- `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` acceptance[5] — blocked(fixture): guest anchor ships unbound (the item's knownGaps[2]).
- `access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only` acceptance[1], negative[0] — blocked(fixture): the walled boot comes up, but the org owner's org-scoped `manage_metadata` grant cannot be placed through any HTTP door (operator insert 403 outside organization scope; owner self-grant 403 under ADR-0090 D12 condition (c)). A seed or a system-write fixture for that grant would close it.
- `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` acceptance[5] — blocked(fixture): needs a showcase DB born under an 18.0.0-next build; a published prerelease CLI resolves 18.1.0 dependencies, so knownGaps should say it is no substitute.
- `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` — marketplace catalog content needs egress to cloud.objectos.ai (the named error state was scored).
- `platform-core.nav-surfaces-render` acceptance[3] — no fixture throws inside a route, so the ErrorBoundary fallback stands on "none encountered".
